proof_body:
by
  intro f c n hf hn ho
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hg0, he⟩ := (meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff hf).mp ho
  rw [meromorphicOrderAt_eq_int_iff hf.deriv]
  refine ⟨fun z => (n : ℂ) * g z + (z - c) * deriv g z, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (analyticAt_const.mul hg).add ((analyticAt_id.sub analyticAt_const).mul hg.deriv)
  · simp [hg0, hn]
  · have h1 : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ, ∀ᶠ y in nhdsWithin z {c}ᶜ, f y = (y - c) ^ n • g y := eventually_eventually_nhdsWithin.mpr he
    have h2 : ∀ᶠ z in nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ, AnalyticAt ℂ g z := nhdsWithin_le_nhds hg.eventually_analyticAt
    filter_upwards [h1, h2, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with z hz1 hz2 hz3
    have hz0 : z - c ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hz3
    rw [isOpen_compl_singleton.nhdsWithin_eq hz3] at hz1
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℂ => (y - c) ^ n) ((n : ℂ) * (z - c) ^ (n - 1)) z :=
      (hasDerivAt_zpow n (z - c) (Or.inl hz0)).comp_sub_const z c
    have hm : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℂ => (y - c) ^ n * g y) ((n : ℂ) * (z - c) ^ (n - 1) * g z + (z - c) ^ n * deriv g z) z :=
      hp.mul hz2.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have hc : deriv f z = deriv (fun y : ℂ => (y - c) ^ n * g y) z := Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq (hz1.mono (fun y hy => by simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hy))
    rw [hc, hm.deriv, smul_eq_mul]
    have : (z - c) ^ n = (z - c) ^ (n - 1) * (z - c) := by
      rw [zpow_sub_one₀ hz0]; field_simp
    rw [this]
    ring
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (n : ℤ), MeromorphicAt f c → n ≠ 0 → meromorphicOrderAt f c = n → meromorphicOrderAt (deriv f) c = ((n - 1 : ℤ) : WithTop ℤ)
